class.name: IfcTextStyleWithBoxCharacteristics
class.brief_description: The text style with box characteristics allows the presentation of annotated text by specifying the characteristics of the character boxes of the text and the spacing between the character boxes. NOTE The IfcTextStyleWithBoxCharacteristics is an entity that had been adopted from ISO 10303, Industrial automation systems and integration—Product data representation and exchange, Part 46: Integrated g

members.member: It is the height scaling factor in the definition of a character glyph. A float, or null when unset. Only in IFC2X3 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
It is the width scaling factor in the definition of a character glyph. A float, or null when unset. Only in IFC2X3 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.

It indicated that the box of a character glyph shall be represented as a parallelogram, with the angle being between the character up line and an axis perpendicular to the character base line. A float, or null when unset. Only in IFC2X3 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.

It indicated that the box of a character glyph shall be presented at an angle to the base line of a text string within which the glyph occurs, the angle being that between the base line of the glyph and an axis perpendicular to the baseline of the text string. A float, or null when unset. Only in IFC2X3 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
The distance between the character boxes of adjacent characters. A value (String, float, int or bool), or null when unset. Only in IFC2X3 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
